While they seem similar, Q2 could theoretically return more results if there are multiple pairs of distinct IDs sharing the same email, but in practice, both return the same set of emails. However, under specific conditions involving NULLs or more complex duplicates, Q2 could return more results. A safer analysis shows they are equivalent in standard usage, but due to potential edge cases, they are not strictly equivalent.
